newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 28-day CDs draw 12.70 pct avg rate at sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru 28-day CDs draw 12.70 pct avg rate at sale.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Thursday it accepted bids for 28-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 30.0 million soles at an effective average annual rate of 12.70 percent during a bank auction
The CDs have a June 6 starting date.
The accepted bids also had a minimum rate of 12.49 percent and a maximum rate of 12.95 percent, the bank said.
The auction was the bank's first CD sale for almost two months.
At the last CD auction April 10, 28-day CDs drew an average rate of 14.79 percent.
At Thursday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 81.8 million soles.
The bank had offered 30 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
